tasks.instruction: You have a part-time job working at a bicycle repair workshop near campus. The technician is showing you how to train people to fix a flat tire. Listen to the technician and repeat what the technician says. Repeat only once.
tasks.sample: First, select the right tool to remove the wheel.
tasks.analysis:
中文：首先，选用合适工具卸下车轮。
复述：First, select the right tool to remove the wheel.
tasks.title: Listen and Repeat

tasks.instruction: You have a part-time job working at a bicycle repair workshop near campus. The technician is showing you how to train people to fix a flat tire. Listen to the technician and repeat what the technician says. Repeat only once.
tasks.analysis:
中文：接着，将轮胎完全放气。
复述：Next, deflate the tire completely.
tasks.title: Listen and Repeat

tasks.instruction: You have a part-time job working at a bicycle repair workshop near campus. The technician is showing you how to train people to fix a flat tire. Listen to the technician and repeat what the technician says. Repeat only once.
